prediction_contract.prediction_timestamp: end of the day before the scheduled flight date (D3)
prediction_contract.target: y = 1 if arr_delay >= 15 minutes, 0 if below; flights without a recorded arrival delay excluded (D4, D6)
prediction_contract.history_rule: historical features use only flights with flight date <= D-2 (D10)

excluded_features.month: Training covers Jan-Aug only; Sep-Dec values would be unseen (decision D15)

calibration_and_threshold_procedure_D11.threshold_rule: on validation predictions unseen by the calibrator (raw if 'none', otherwise cross-fitted by month), choose the threshold with precision >= 0.70 and maximum recall; ties to the highest threshold; infeasible if none (D7)
calibration_and_threshold_procedure_D11.final_calibrator: selected method refitted on all validation predictions
calibration_and_threshold_procedure_D11.limitation_D33: cross-fitting with month-specific maps reorders flights between months; on raw LR scores 70% precision occurs only at the top 7 validation flights (5 delayed), in 60% of day resamples; D11 kept unchanged

test_evaluation_plan.implementation: scripts/evaluate_test.py (hash-pinned in this proposal) using flight_delay.evaluation.final.evaluate_predictions; not run before approval
order_of_operations: 1. load and validate the FROZEN manifest (bound to this proposal and all hashes) before loading data
2. load hash-pinned artifacts; a deterministic refit on training rows must reproduce their validation predictions exactly; calibrator parameters must match
3. score test-period features without labels; save predictions (no labels) and their SHA-256
4. release test labels once via unlock_test_labels (logged with manifest hash and predictions hash)
5. compute the registered metrics below and write reports/final/test_evaluation.json and figures
test_evaluation_plan.single_access: Exactly one release. The lock refuses a second release unless a repeat reason is given; a repeat is permitted only to fix a software defect that changes no frozen decision, and both outputs must be disclosed.

models_scored.primary: logistic_regression_sigmoid: Logistic Regression (C=0.01, L2, lbfgs, unweighted) + sigmoid calibrator fitted on all validation predictions
models_scored.comparison: xgboost_isotonic: XGBoost (xgboost_01) + isotonic calibrator fitted on all validation predictions

metric_definitions.log_loss: binary cross-entropy with probabilities clipped to [1e-15, 1 - 1e-15]
metric_definitions.calibration_intercept_slope: unpenalised logistic regression of y on logit(clip(q, 1e-15, 1-1e-15)); slope = coefficient, intercept = constant; ideal (0, 1); reported as 'undefined (constant prediction)' for constant predictions; descriptive only, never applied
metric_definitions.reliability: up to 10 quantile bins of q; bins with duplicate edges merged (fewer bins possible for step-shaped isotonic outputs); per bin: n, mean q, observed rate

secondary_descriptive: the same point metrics for raw (uncalibrated) LR and XGBoost
point metrics and calibration-in-the-large by month (2013-11, 2013-12)
validation vs test: prevalence and mean predicted probability

threshold_dependent_metrics.statement: No operating threshold — the 70% precision target was infeasible on validation.
not_computed: confusion matrix at an operating threshold
threshold_dependent_metrics.figures: Precision-recall and ROC curves are shown descriptively with the 0.70 precision line; no threshold is read from them or reported as an operating point.

uncertainty.method: 95% percentile intervals; day-block bootstrap: 200 resamples of whole test flight dates with replacement; seed 42 (D28); the same resampled days for every model and metric
uncertainty.undefined_resamples: resamples in which a metric is undefined are excluded and counted (n_undefined)
uncertainty.paired_sign_convention: difference = metric(primary) - metric(other); AP and ROC AUC > 0 favour the primary model; Brier and log loss < 0 favour it
uncertainty.constant_baselines: computed with the same code; ROC AUC of a constant prediction is 0.5 by construction (degenerate interval); AP equals prevalence; calibration slope undefined

test_evaluation_plan.error_analysis: Any later test-set error analysis (plan Stage 9) is exploratory and cannot change the frozen pipeline.
